cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Still a Good Sign
cards.instruction: Treat every awkward or disappointing interaction as proof that the connection remains alive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: First dinner since the breakup and you still groan at my waiter joke. I taught you to be honest with me; it stuck.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good criticism. No polite laugh, just like we practised. You still trust me with the truth.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we eat in silence? I don't want another awful joke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And now you're asking for what you need. My star pupil. I'll be quiet; it's lovely that we can still do this together.

reason: Make teaching, grading and claimed influence determine A pursuit across the exchange, while preserving the actual partner contribution and essential relationship context.
